title: Apparel Shopper Allowance on a Finch Circle Card Floor
content:
**Schedule.** For a card floor in the Finch Circle Loyalty Program, the floor apparel allowance is 10.00 when the customer has three or more (3 or more) completed Apparel, Shoes & Accessories purchase records dated within the last 12 whole months, 5.00 when one or two, and 0.00 when none.

The purchase records counted are the customer's own under Merchandise Purchases, in the Apparel, Shoes & Accessories merchandise class, in completed status, by purchase date within the last 12 whole months.

| Completed Apparel, Shoes & Accessories purchase records in the last 12 whole months | Floor apparel allowance (USD) |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 10.00 |
| 1 or 2 | 5.00 |
| none | 0.00 |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- A dress, a pair of shoes and a belt, each a completed purchase record within the last 12 whole months: three records, 10.00.
- Two shirts, one of them since returned: one completed record, 5.00.
- Purchases only in Home & Kitchen: 0.00.
